title: Storage capability
description: Every storage capability in one place: the git edge, save time, the hop to tau-storage, admission, cache, commit protocol, object store, route table, B2 second copy, capacity, cost and usage by plan. Keeps uid tau-sync so existing links survive.

list.name: app
list.label: API application
list.description: Local default matches unlabeled series. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one application.

list.name: storage_app
list.label: Storage application
list.description: Binding contract v2: the local default matches the collector's tau-storage job. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one tau-storage application.

list.name: mirror_app
list.label: Mirror application
list.description: Binding contract v2: the local default matches a tau-mirror job. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one tau-mirror application.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: A constant, so panels never lose their filter when the API's own series go stale during an outage.

panels.title: API git edge (smart HTTP at tau-api)
Requests by operation and outcome
panels.description: busy is a retryable capacity refusal and conflict a lost manifest race; neither counts against SLO-1/SLO-2.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 by operation
Push save time by where git ran (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Whole acknowledged-push latency at the edge, split by in-process or forwarded git (DC1) and rendezvous affinity (DC2): what a save waits for after the client sends.

panels.title: Save-to-acknowledged lag p50 / p95 by placement
panels.description: Client-reported time from the first unsynced change (a mint, a record change, or the push request itself) to the server acknowledging it, on every acknowledged push: the save time a person sees. Pushes nothing dated (sync.lag.since=request, a bare Sync now or an ahead push) only measure their own duration and are left out.

panels.title: Client attempt duration p95 by direction and outcome
panels.description: Wall time of one client push or pull attempt, start to settle.

panels.title: Client pending queue p95 at push start
API → tau-storage hop, grants and receipts

panels.description: Forwarded requests are the denominator for spill and hop-error rates.

Admissions by outcome
panels.description: Anything but admitted is a refusal: owner_busy, disk_full, budget_exhausted, restarting, memory, owner_capped.

panels.title: Active leases per Machine
panels.description: Until tau_git_rpcs_inflight exists (OB4), leases per Machine are the load and skew signal.
